evals.name: single-unit-apply-after-mutate
evals.prompt: I just bumped the checkout image in myapp-staging via cub-mutate. Apply the new revision.
evals.expected_output: Preflights (TargetID populated, worker healthy, no ApplyGates), optionally does a quick --dry-run for confirmation, then `cub unit apply checkout --space myapp-staging --wait --timeout 2m0s`. Does NOT pass --change-desc. Hands off to verify-apply for post-apply classification + close-out. Does not call kubectl apply.

evals.name: rollback-to-last-applied
evals.prompt: The deploy I just did broke payments in myapp-prod. Roll it back to the previous applied revision.
evals.expected_output: Identifies intent as rollback, uses `cub unit apply payments --space myapp-prod --revision LastAppliedRevisionNum --wait`. Clarifies whether the user also wants to move the Unit's head revision back (which is a separate cub-mutate --restore operation), not just the applied state. Confirms the actual revision number via cub revision list before running, hands off to verify-apply after.

evals.name: bulk-apply-unapplied-changes
evals.prompt: Apply all the pending changes we have staged in myapp-prod. We approved them this morning.
evals.expected_output: Uses cub unit apply --space myapp-prod --filter platform/unapplied-changes --wait --timeout 5m0s (or an equivalent --where "HeadRevisionNum > LiveRevisionNum"), confirms blast radius with the user before running, checks that none of the selected units have ApplyGates (stops and routes to triggers-and-applygates if they do), and hands off to verify-apply across the same set.
